title: stipa lingua subsp. magnifica
intro: Stipa lingua subsp. magnifica, commonly known as the Giant Limestone Brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Stipa lingua subsp. magnifica include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and calm anxiety. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
